capabilities: Translate selected text in a sidebar panel
Sync edited translations back into the source-language text
Review pending write-backs with deletions, additions, and ambiguity candidates
Explain selections and answer follow-up questions with AI
Apply scientific terminology mappings to translations
disambiguation: Not a one-way translation viewer; edited translations are written back to revise the source-language text.
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. README warns that API keys are stored unencrypted in data.json and must never be committed or attached to releases, and that selected passages plus context are sent to the chosen provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, and non-native English researchers need to read and write technical Markdown without breaking equations, citations, code, and links.
